title: UnsupportedTypeSupport: Could not import 'rosidl_typesupport_c' for package in rclpy: venv-built interfaces, LD_LIBRARY_PATH and the rebuild that fixes it, measured
excerpt: Why rclpy fails with Could not import 'rosidl_typesupport_c' for a custom message: interfaces built while a Python 3.11 venv was active, or a workspace lib dir missing from LD_LIBRARY_PATH. Plain rebuilds kept it broken; --cmake-clean-cache or rm -rf fixed it on Humble, Jazzy and Lyrical.
